items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: When you see a show, Bill Bale and all of them comes out, it don't be one man got that.

ctx.x: Do you know any other numbers that you played for her, or did you have any other numbers by yourself?

Well, no, we all, we had what they called, we had other old pieces we used to play, the blues, old time blues like that. And let me see, there's another thing they called the tromboners. There's plenty of tromboneers like that. And then, somebody stole my gal and all that. You know, and all the more, and then she'd be cutting the steps and dancing. Then we'd put it in the two-fourth time. See? We'd make it through that so she could make her steps right. See? Nothing couldn't be slow because we wanted her to cut…
